name: Rimrock Banff Resort
positioning: Mountain resort on the slopes of Sulphur Mountain in Banff National Park, now named Rimrock Banff, Emblems Collection
best_for: Travelers who want a base moments from the Banff Upper Hot Springs and the Banff Gondola
Skiers and hikers exploring Banff National Park

facts.text: The resort rises from the slopes of Sulphur Mountain, above the forest canopy.
The resort is surrounded by Banff National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
Rimrock Banff is the first Emblems Collection hotel in North America.
The resort sits above the valley, moments from Banff Upper Hot Springs and the Banff Gondola.
The resort is just over 1.5 hours west of Calgary International Airport.
Premium Forest View rooms have views of Mount Rundle and the Bow Valley.
The resort has a Bathhouse and Fitness facility.
Personal training is offered in all seasons.
In winter, the Rimrock Ski Connector takes guests to Banff's ski hills, with a stop at the Banff Springs Hotel.
Parker's Table is the signature restaurant, celebrating Canadian terroir.
Rimrock Market serves craft beers, cocktails and house-made gelato, with seasonal programming such as fireside Bombardino evenings.

highlights.text: The Wellness Studio with Private Terrace has Technogym equipment, Hyperice tools, aromatherapy and Canadian wellness amenities.
With the Aurora Wake-Up Call, guests can sign up to be called and woken if the northern lights appear during their stay.
The Infinity Two Bedroom Suite is a top-level suite with an expansive balcony overlooking the Rockies.
Mountain Goat Adventures offers private guided hikes led by certified guide Jeff Douglas.

considerations.text: Golf is off-site at Fairmont Banff Springs and is played in spring, summer and fall.
WhataHotel notes the elevated hillside setting means a short shuttle or drive to reach the Banff town center.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the resort's high-end positioning in the Canadian Rockies.
